Theme: The Human Behind the Machine.
Tagline: Curiosity builds things. Experiences shape people. The journey never stops.

## Now

- Web development intern at Maaricha, April 2024–September 2024, Hazratganj, Lucknow. Website maintenance, database consistency, WordPress, Wix, and troubleshooting. Worked on the Ivani Diamonds site.
- Managed the Storm Esports Discord, about 15,000 members: scrims, small BGMI tournaments, registrations, bots, roles, and community operations.
- Personal projects in Golang: a simple web server, a Slack age bot, and an email checker. An online resume builder in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript from B.Tech summer training.
- Interests, not claimed expertise: AI data quality and content evaluation, and mobile-gaming LiveOps.

## Skills
